'''Avilatan''' was an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was volcanic and had several lava pools.

Considered the birthplace of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], Avilatan was a contested island during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Several key locations on Avilatan during the Separatist War included the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] base of operations, [[Fort Garnik]], and the Separatists' base of operations, [[Mount Avilatan]], which contained the [[Separatist stronghold]].

The [[Avilatan Badlands]] was one of many contested battle zones on the island. Several villages, such as [[Drelliad village|Drelliad]], [[Oradam village|Oradam]], and [[Talloran village|Talloran]], were also on the island. Nearby, the island of [[Mannett Point]] was a key base for Separatist forces.

Avilatan was home to many indigenous species. [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|Mantellian flutterplumes]] could be found in small packs throughout the island. Flutterplumes often fed on soldiers killed during battle. [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] could be also be found in Avilatan, although they mostly resided on an island nearby.
